long_function.title: {function_name} is too long ({line_count} lines)
long_function.description: {function_name} handles {responsibility_count} responsibilities — this edge case was missed.
long_function.future_scenario: As {function_name} grows, changes to one responsibility may unintentionally affect another, potentially introducing unexpected bugs.
long_function.impact: Increased debugging time, difficult maintenance, and a higher risk of regression errors.
long_function.recommendation: Split the function into smaller functions, each handling one responsibility.

suggested_fix.python:
# one responsibility per helper
def {function_name}(self, ...):
    self._validate_input(...)
    charge = self._charge(...)
    self._reserve_and_screen(...)
    return charge

duplicate_logic.title: Duplicate validation logic causes inconsistent error messages
duplicate_logic.description: The same validation was copy-pasted in {count} places and diverged over time.
duplicate_logic.future_scenario: If validation rules change in one location but not the others, different parts of the application may accept inconsistent or invalid inputs.
duplicate_logic.impact: Inconsistent application behaviour, validation failures, and potential data integrity issues.
duplicate_logic.recommendation: Extract duplicated validation into a reusable function or shared module.

suggested_fix.python:
# this line appears {count} times — keep one shared helper and call it twice
self._shared_step(promo)

# then delete the duplicate copy

complex_condition.title: Overly complex conditional in {function_name}
complex_condition.description: The conditional at line {line} has {condition_count} branches — consider extracting into a guard clause or helper.
complex_condition.future_scenario: As additional conditions are introduced, an overlooked logical combination may cause the application to follow an unintended execution path.
complex_condition.impact: Incorrect decisions, unexpected application behaviour, and difficult debugging.
complex_condition.recommendation: Break complex conditions into smaller, clearly named boolean expressions or helper functions.

suggested_fix.python:
# name each part of the condition, then combine the named parts

if not is_ready:

bare_except.title: Bare except swallows errors in {function_name}
bare_except.description: A bare exception handler at line {line} catches all exceptions, hiding bugs and making debugging harder.
bare_except.future_scenario: An unexpected runtime error may be silently suppressed, allowing the application to continue with incomplete or incorrect results.
bare_except.impact: Hidden failures, unreliable application behaviour, and difficult troubleshooting.
bare_except.recommendation: Catch specific exception types and log unexpected errors appropriately.

unused_import.title: Unused import '{module}' in {file}
unused_import.description: The import '{module}' is never used and should be removed.
unused_import.future_scenario: Unnecessary dependencies may increase maintenance overhead and can create avoidable dependency-management problems.
unused_import.impact: Code clutter, reduced readability, and potentially unnecessary dependency overhead.
unused_import.recommendation: Remove unused imports and keep dependencies minimal.
